Local Parallel Mock SLURM Scheduler Backend

Source: R/backend_mock.R
MockSlurmBackend.Rd

Full-featured local SLURM array simulator that executes the exact generated worker.R script in isolated background R processes via processx, throttled by a configurable concurrency queue (max_workers). Supports live OS RSS polling via ps, disk-based atomic chunk checkpoints, real or simulated FAILED / OUT_OF_MEMORY / TIMEOUT / CANCELLED states, surgical retry of failed chunks, cancellation, log inspection, and ordered result collection — enabling 100% offline development and testing on a laptop.

Public fields

name

Backend identifier ("mock_slurm").

root_dir

Root directory storing simulated job workspaces.

max_workers

Maximum concurrent background R worker processes.

queue_delay

Optional simulated queue wait delay in seconds before dispatching pending chunks.

mem_limit_mb

Optional enforced RSS limit in MB (exceeding triggers OUT_OF_MEMORY).

time_limit_sec

Optional enforced walltime limit in seconds (exceeding triggers TIMEOUT).

fault_injection

Default fault injection specification (fail_chunks, oom_chunks, timeout_chunks, fail_once).

rscript_bin

Path to the Rscript executable used for worker processes.

MockSlurmBackend$new()

Create a new MockSlurmBackend.

Usage

MockSlurmBackend$new(
  root_dir = NULL,
  max_workers = 2L,
  queue_delay = 0,
  mem_limit_mb = NULL,
  time_limit_sec = NULL,
  fault_injection = list(),
  rscript_bin = NULL
)

Arguments

root_dir

Optional directory path for job staging and checkpoints. Defaults to a unique temporary directory.

max_workers

Positive integer maximum concurrent worker slots. Default 2L.

queue_delay

Non-negative numeric queue delay in seconds before starting pending chunks. Default 0.

mem_limit_mb

Optional positive numeric RSS ceiling in MB to actively enforce against background worker processes.

time_limit_sec

Optional positive numeric walltime ceiling in seconds to actively enforce against background worker processes.

fault_injection

Optional named list with any of fail_chunks, oom_chunks, timeout_chunks (integer vectors) and fail_once (logical, default TRUE).

rscript_bin

Optional explicit path to Rscript. Defaults to the active R installation's Rscript.

MockSlurmBackend$set_fault_injection()

Update default fault injection rules for future submissions.

Usage

MockSlurmBackend$set_fault_injection(
  fail_chunks = integer(),
  oom_chunks = integer(),
  timeout_chunks = integer(),
  fail_once = TRUE
)

Arguments

fail_chunks

Integer vector of chunk IDs to fail.

oom_chunks

Integer vector of chunk IDs to OOM-kill.

timeout_chunks

Integer vector of chunk IDs to timeout-kill.

fail_once

Logical; if TRUE (default), faults trigger only on attempt 1.
